Edge List of a Spatial Graph

Source: R/pattern_spatial.R
graph_edges.Rd

Edge List of a Spatial Graph

Usage

graph_edges(graph)

Arguments

graph

A spatial_graph.

Value

A data frame with integer columns from and to (column positions, from < to) and a numeric weight.

See also

spatial_graph

Examples

ds <- gen_sample_dataset(c(4, 4, 4), 8)
head(graph_edges(spatial_graph(ds$dataset)))
#>   from to weight
#> 1    1  2      1
#> 2    2  3      1
#> 3    3  4      1
#> 4    1  5      1
#> 5    2  6      1
#> 6    5  6      1
